visuals.description: A blackboard split into two panels on the left, illustrating the Intermediate Value Theorem. The top panel has hypotheses (a,b in R, f: [a,b] -> R continuous, f(a)<0, f(b)>0) alongside a coordinate-plane sketch of a curve crossing the x-axis between points a and b, with the curve labeled f(a) at the bottom and f(b) at the top. The bottom panel states the Intermediate Value Theorem with two sketches: a line crossing the axis, and a crossed-out 'Not cont.' diagram of intersecting lines. A lecturer stands at the right board, partly blocking it.

a, b ∈ R.
